name: io.github.lucasr1b/sketchdex
title: Sketchdex
description: An MCP server that lets AI agents draw hand-drawn Excalidraw diagrams as files on your machine.

environmentVariables.name: SKETCHDEX_VAULT
environmentVariables.description: Folder where scenes are stored. Default: ~/Documents/sketchdex

environmentVariables.name: SKETCHDEX_BROWSER
environmentVariables.description: Path to a Chromium-based browser binary used for render_scene. Default: the first of Chrome, Chromium, Edge or Brave found on the machine
